title: 第25章 宿敌第26章 试探
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
叶梦茵强吗？
那自然是强的。
同为筑基三层，她也是实力强劲的那批人中的一份子。
但朔衡能看出来，徐子龙从这场战斗的开始，就在酝酿一记杀招。
所有的躲避，所有的进攻，都是为这个杀招做的掩饰。
而破绽，也很简单。
他所修炼的这门武技，乃是玄阶上品——幽夜净土。
这门武技虽然只有玄阶上品，但修炼难度却不低于地阶。
究其原因，也是因为这武技跟阵法有些关联。
所以，只要找到徐子龙隐匿在场地之中的“阵符”并将其破除，就能简单将杀招破解。
可惜，叶梦茵因为徐子龙时不时的骚扰，并未及时察觉。
于筑基修士而言，他们体内的灵气正常情况下根本无法支撑他们使用地阶以上的武技。
玄阶上品，已然拥有此阶段中顶了尖儿的威力。
朔衡点了点手指：“要来了。”
话音刚落，擂台中央，风暴裹挟着黑雾瞬间散开。
漆黑的雾色笼罩之下，叶梦茵甚至感觉自己体内的灵气运转都变得滞涩起来。
她不由得面色大变。
“你……！什么时候？！”
徐子龙没有回答。
只有他手中闪耀着黑光的匕首，表达了绝对不会手下留情的决心。

叶梦茵立刻召回绸缎，将自己裹成一个圆形的粽子。
可惜，为时已晚。
“给我——破！”
轰——
刹那间，轰鸣声炸开。
看台之上众人一片哗然。
原本他们都以为徐子龙的手段被克制了，没想到，他竟然一直在憋着大招。
这一仗，打得漂亮！
“徐师弟，好样的！”
“徐师弟威武！”
黑雾散开后，露出了擂台上的场景。
叶梦茵本是个光彩照人的美人儿，如今却灰头土脸，衣冠散乱。
她的肩膀上有一道被利器刺穿的伤口，正冉冉流着鲜血。
危机时刻，徐子龙自然是移开了原本对准人脖颈的匕首。
content_en:
Is Ye Mengyin strong?
That is naturally strong.
She is also on the third level of foundation building, and she is also part of a strong group of people.
But Shuo Heng could tell that Xu Zilong had been preparing a killing move from the beginning of this battle.
All evasions and attacks are all disguises for this ultimate move.
The flaw is also very simple.
The martial arts he practiced was a top-grade Xuan level - Youye Pure Land.
Although this martial art is only at the upper level of the Xuan level, its difficulty is not lower than that of the Earth level.
The reason is also because this martial skill is somewhat related to the formation.
Therefore, as long as Xu Zilong's "formation talisman" hidden in the venue is found and destroyed, the killing move can be easily broken.
Unfortunately, Ye Mengyin did not notice it in time because of Xu Zilong's harassment from time to time.
For foundation-building monks, the spiritual energy in their bodies cannot support them to use martial arts above the earth level under normal circumstances.
The high-grade Xuan level already possesses the most powerful power at this stage.
Shuo Heng pointed his finger: "It's coming."
As soon as he finished speaking, in the center of the arena, the black mist dispersed in an instant as the storm enveloped him.
Under the dark fog, Ye Mengyin even felt that the spiritual energy in her body had become stagnant.
She couldn't help but change her face.
"You...! When?!"
Xu Zilong did not answer.
Only the dagger shining with black light in his hand expressed his determination to show no mercy.
Ye Mengyin immediately recalled the silk and satin and wrapped herself into a round rice dumpling.
Unfortunately, it's too late.
"Give it to me - break it!"
Boom——
In an instant, a roar exploded.
Everyone in the stands was in an uproar.
Originally, they all thought that Xu Zilong's methods were restrained, but to their surprise, he had been holding back his ultimate move.
This battle was well fought!
"Junior Brother Xu, well done!"
"Junior Brother Xu is mighty!"
After the black mist dispersed, the scene on the ring was revealed.
Ye Mengyin was originally a dazzling beauty, but now she is gray and disheveled.
There was a wound on her shoulder that was pierced by a sharp weapon, and blood was slowly flowing out.
At the critical moment, Xu Zilong naturally removed the dagger originally aimed at the person's neck.
